helps.authHeaderName: Enter the request header name required by the service.
helps.authHeaderSecret: The platform will write this secret into the Header above.
helps.authMethod: Select the authentication method the platform uses when calling the Agent service.
helps.authSecret: The platform sends this as Authorization: Bearer Token.
helps.baseUrl: Enter the protocol, domain, and port of the Agent service, without a specific endpoint path.
helps.description: Describe the tasks this Agent is suited for, so it can be selected later when submitting evaluations.
helps.invokeMode: Submit and Poll is for asynchronous tasks; Synchronous Response is for requests that return results directly.
helps.name: Used to identify this Agent in the platform. A service or capability name is recommended.
helps.pollInterval: Wait time between two platform result queries.
helps.pollTimeout: The platform stops waiting if the task does not reach a terminal state within this time.
helps.requestTimeout: Maximum time to wait for one submission request response.
helps.resultPathTemplate: Path used to query task results in polling mode. The {externalRunId} placeholder is supported.
helps.statusSuccess: Enter status values that represent successful tasks. They must be included in the terminal status set.
helps.statusTerminal: Enter terminal status values returned by the Agent. Separate multiple values with commas or new lines.
helps.structuredOutput: The platform adds a structured output field to the request body.
helps.structuredOutputAlias: Enter the top-level field name in the Agent request body that receives the output schema.
helps.taskPath: Path called by the platform when submitting a task. It is joined with the service base URL.

inputMappingHelp.entryUrl: Optional. When a start URL is needed, the platform writes the sample entry into this field.
inputMappingHelp.evaluationId: Optional. Fill in this field name when the evaluation task ID is needed for tracing.
inputMappingHelp.maxSteps: Optional. Fill in this field name when the Agent maximum execution steps need to be limited.
inputMappingHelp.sampleId: Optional. Fill in this field name when the sample ID is needed for tracing.
inputMappingHelp.task: Required. Enter the top-level field name in the Agent request body that receives the task objective, such as prompt.
inputMappingHelp.timeoutSeconds: Optional. Fill in this field name when task-level timeout is needed.

registerForm.notVisibleSecretPlaceholder: Written at creation; plaintext is not shown on the details page

outputMappingHelp.errorMessage: Optional. Enter the path to the error message so failure reasons can be displayed, such as error.message.
outputMappingHelp.externalRunId: Required in polling mode. Enter the path to the run ID in the submission response; use runId for a top-level field or data.runId for a nested field.
outputMappingHelp.finalAnswer: Optional. Enter the path to the final answer or text result, such as answer or output.answer.
outputMappingHelp.status: Required in polling mode. Enter the path to the status field in the result response; use status for a top-level field or data.status for a nested field.

validation.statusSuccessInTerminal: Success statuses must belong to the terminal status set
